title: An inventory module with tests
description:
Put an inventory in a module and test it.

```
added 5 apples, 3 pears
removed 2 apples
stock: apple 3, pear 3
removing 10 pears: not enough (only 3)
tests: 4 passed
```
hints: Code outside the module can only use what is `pub`; `items` stays hidden, so `main` must go through the methods (lesson 3.05).
`remove` checks `self.count(name) < n` first, and removes the entry when it reaches 0.
requirements: `mod inventory { pub struct Inventory { items: HashMap<String, u32> } ... }`: the field stays private.
`pub fn add`, `pub fn remove(&mut self, name: &str, n: u32) -> Result<(), String>`, `pub fn count`.
A `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with at least four `#[test]` functions. On the website, also call simple checks from `main`.
stretch: Split the module into its own file (`inventory.rs`) in a Cargo project on your computer and run `cargo test`.
